meta: 24/7 emergency plumbing for Brentwood, CA through the Oakley 24/7 Plumbing dispatch line. Emergency drain cleaning and water heater replacement. Call now.
lead: Calls for an emergency plumber in Brentwood, CA go to the Oakley 24/7 Plumbing dispatch line, which takes calls around the clock for clogged mains, leaks and failed water heaters.
Brentwood uses ZIP 94513, and a clear price comes before any work starts.
intro: Emergency plumbing in Brentwood means a drain, leak or water heater failure that cannot safely wait for business hours. Brentwood adjoins Oakley on Oakley's south side, in Contra Costa County, so the dispatch line serves a neighboring city and not a distant county.
This page covers the calls we see most, what to do before we arrive, how Brentwood's own water system affects your repair, and which nearby ZIP codes we also serve.

overview_cards.d: Calls from Brentwood reach dispatch overnight, on weekends and on holidays, with no separate after-hours line.
The scope and the number are agreed first, so a drain or tank job does not grow without your say.
Contained problems like a slow shower drain can often be booked for the same day.

prep_cards.h2: Before We Arrive: Steps for a Brentwood Home

items.d: Look for the main shutoff where the water line enters the house, often on an exterior wall, a garage wall or near the heater. Turn it clockwise until it stops, then open a low faucet to bleed off pressure.
If water has reached a garage, laundry room or kitchen outlet, flip that breaker at the panel and stay out of the standing water until the circuit is off.
Move cars from the garage bay, lift rugs and clear the path to the water heater, the sink cabinet or the cleanout so access takes minutes and not half an hour.
Phone (888) 910-8644 and give your cross street, any gate code and what you have already shut off. Gated communities like Carmel Estates need the entry steps up front.

sections.h2: Brentwood plumbing emergencies we answer first
paras: Three problems dominate emergency calls from Brentwood: a main drain that will not clear, a leak that keeps spreading, and a water heater that has started to flood a closet or garage. Dispatch is staffed 24/7, so a midnight call is handled the same way as a morning call, and the steps below keep damage small while you wait.
Smelling gas in a Brentwood home means getting everyone out and calling 911 and PG&E at 1-800-743-5000 before anything else. Only after that should you phone a plumber.
do_now: Stop using water fixtures if a drain is backing up, because every flush or rinse sends more water toward the low point.
For a leaking tank, shut the cold-water valve on top of the heater and switch off its power or gas control.
Close the main valve for any leak you cannot locate, then watch whether the ceiling or wall stops dripping.
Put towels and buckets under active drips and move furniture away from the wet area.
Take photos of the water and the damaged items before you clean up.
Call dispatch and tell us the cross street, the fixture involved and what you have turned off.

sections.h2: Drain cleaning for Brentwood kitchens, baths and main lines
paras: A single slow sink usually needs a cable and an hour. When the tub, the toilet and the washing machine all drain badly together, the blockage is in the main line, and [[drain-cleaning|emergency drain cleaning]] with a larger machine reaches it.

If the same line blocks again within a few months, ask for a camera look and consider [[hydro-jetting|hydro jetting]] to scour roots and grease off the pipe wall. Brentwood grew quickly after 1990, when suburban development replaced many farms and orchards, so do not assume your pipe material from the neighborhood. Ask a plumber to identify it.

sections.h2: Brentwood's water system and what it means for repairs
paras: Brentwood runs its own water system, and the City of Brentwood publishes its own water quality reports. In 2023 its supply came from the Brentwood Water Treatment Plant, city wells and water purchased from the Randall-Bold Water Treatment Plant, serving more than 21,000 connections. If a leak sits between the street and your meter, start with the City, not the water district that serves Oakley.

No hardness figure is on hand here, so ask the City of Brentwood for its annual water quality report and read the hardness line. That number tells you whether a tankless heater needs regular descaling or a softener is worth pricing. Permit questions for water heater swaps or repipes go to the City of Brentwood Building Division. Plumbing in Brentwood is held to the same California Plumbing Code (UPC-based), which applies statewide, as in Oakley.

sections.h2: Water heater replacement in Brentwood garages and closets
paras: A tank that is leaking from the body cannot be patched, and [[water-heater-replacement|water heater replacement]] is the fix, often the same day when parts allow. Choose between a like-for-like tank and a tankless unit based on the space, the gas and electrical supply, and how many fixtures run at once. State law, Health and Safety Code 19211, requires the new heater to be braced or strapped against earthquake movement.

If you live in Trilogy at the Vineyards, an active adult community, tell us up front where the heater sits and clear the path to it before we arrive. A leak that began before the tank failed may be a supply pipe, which is a job for [[leak-detection|leak detection]] rather than a new heater.

sections.h2: Helping us find your address fast
paras: At night, street names and house numbers are easy to confuse in any growing city, so a few extra details save time.

items.d: Name the nearest feature, such as the Delta Theater downtown, Streets of Brentwood or the Marsh Creek Regional Trail, when the street sign is hard to read.
A gated community such as Carmel Estates needs a gate code or a call-in to the guard, so have it ready before you dial.
An agricultural core of about 11,000 acres borders Brentwood on three sides, so give the cross street and a driveway marker if your home sits near the edge.

faqs.q: Is emergency service available in Brentwood?
a: Yes. Dispatch runs 24/7, so a flooded laundry room on a Sunday night or a backed-up main on a holiday gets a live answer from the same line.
Describe the fixture, the water you can see and what you have shut off. That tells us whether to treat the job as a tonight visit or schedule it for the next available slot.

faqs.q: Do you cover every ZIP code in Brentwood?
a: Brentwood is served by ZIP 94513, and that is the ZIP this page is built around. We also work in the neighboring communities: Oakley, 94561, which adjoins Brentwood on its north side, and Knightsen, 94548, the rural community nearest to Oakley.

Antioch, which uses 94509 and 94531, sits west of Oakley, and Bethel Island, 94511, is reached across the Cypress Road bridge from Oakley. The [[service-area|service area]] page shows how those towns connect to Oakley.
The City of Brentwood operates its own water system and publishes its own water quality reports.
Ask the City whether a leak near your meter falls on its side or yours. We cannot confirm where the City's responsibility ends.

faqs.q: Does a new water heater in Brentwood need a permit?
a: Permit rules vary, so ask the City of Brentwood Building Division before work begins. A licensed contractor can often handle the paperwork, but confirm that with the City.
Whatever the answer, the heater must be braced or strapped under Health and Safety Code 19211.

faqs.q: What should I have ready when I call from Brentwood?
a: Have your street address and nearest cross street, the fixture or room involved, and what you have already turned off. If your community is gated, have the code or the guard's instructions at hand.
